priority_vectors: Injection into external API URL construction (SSRF-like)
Input validation bypass on format validators (SIREN, IBAN, SIRET, VAT, UID)
Authentication bypass when ApiKeys array is empty or misconfigured
Information disclosure via error messages or response metadata
coverage_gaps: File upload vulnerabilities (no file upload endpoints)
Race conditions (stateless, no shared mutable state)

external_apis.name: INSEE
external_apis.note: Proxies calls to French establishment registry

external_apis.name: VIES
external_apis.note: Proxies VAT number validation to EU VIES

authentication.note: Single header-based API key auth. Auto-succeeds anonymously if ApiKeys array is empty or misconfigured.

false_positive_rules.reason: JSON-only API, no HTML rendering context

attack_surface_summary: GET-only REST API with 6 exposed endpoints plus health check, all requiring X-Api-Key header except health. Thin input validation on structured identifiers (SIREN, IBAN, SIRET, VAT, UID). External HTTP/SOAP calls to 5 upstream registries. No database, no file upload, no stateful operations.
